brief:
Health workers in Gaza are running a breast cancer awareness campaign titled "pink blooms from among the rubble," according to Al Jazeera English. The initiative seeks to promote screening and education about the disease despite ongoing hardship in the territory.

The campaign reflects efforts by medical professionals to maintain public health services under difficult circumstances, addressing a disease that continues to affect women in Gaza regardless of the broader conflict.
dek: Health workers in Gaza are participating in a breast cancer campaign called ‘pink blooms from among the rubble’.
title: Gaza health workers launch breast cancer awareness campaign amid conflict
